tools.name: find_cocktails
tools.description: Finds cocktails that can be made with the ingredients the user has at home (exact matching against a curated recipe database: staples like ice and sugar count as available, garnishes are ignored). Optionally also returns drinks missing only 1–2 ingredients. Ingredient names may be given in English,

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Returns a full cocktail recipe (ingredients with amounts, steps, glass, history) as Markdown, plus the link to the recipe page with photo, party calculator and ratings.

tools.name: missing_ingredients
tools.description: Tells which ingredients are still missing to make a given cocktail with what the user has.

tools.name: search_cocktails
tools.description: Searches cocktails by name, ingredient or taste (fruity, sour, sweet, bitter, fresh, creamy, spicy, smoky, sparkling), optionally only non-alcoholic.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Cocktailline recipes. Returns ids, titles and URLs; use fetch for the full recipe.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a Cocktailline recipe by id (as returned by search).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
